node.statement: An extended D_*t-isomorphism is in particular the extended D_*t-inclusion required by lem-maincb-reset-invariant-preservation. Substitute D=D_* there: D_*>=1; W.c0_cb=c0>=max{c0^0,K_floor,C_unit(K_floor+1)}; W.r_reset is at most epsilon_max^cb, delta_max^cb/D_*, e_it/(D_*+1), epsilon_unit, delta_unit/max{1,K_floor}, a_unit/((1+K_disp)D_*), and [2(1+K_disp)D_*]^{-1}; and each call has 0<=t<=W.r_reset, epsilon_R<=t, map defect at most D_*t, and unit error at most D_*t. These are precisely that lemma's hypotheses, so each literal call is reset-eligible and meets the stated M02/M03 and near-unit thresholds.
